column3: Use MenuPanel (Sources/Panel/MenuPanel.swift). An NSPopover on the status item keeps the fullscreen menu bar from auto-hiding, even after quit.
Read the computer name with SCDynamicStoreCopyComputerName. Host.current() blocks on name resolution on the main thread.
Read byte counters from InterfaceCounters (NET_RT_IFLIST2). if_data counters are 32-bit and wrap every 4 GB.
Use GlassBackground (AppKit) or glassCard/glassButton/GlassGroup (SwiftUI) so macOS 14 and 15 still launch.
Store secrets through APIKeyStore. The ad-hoc signed app makes the Keychain ask for a password after every rebuild.
Format dates with Date.FormatStyle(..., locale: Lang.locale). formatted(date:time:) uses the system language, not the app language.
